descriptions.zh: 我们开始在§Y[from.target.GetName]§!进行隐秘活动。间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]现在开始全权负责[from.target.GetAdj]中快速发展的§H间谍网§!。
descriptions.en: Our presence in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has taken on a clandestine aspect. Spymaster [from.leader.GetName] is now situated at the core of a burgeoning §HSpy Network§! in [from.target.GetAdj] space.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

descriptions.zh: 我们开始在§Y[from.target.GetName]§!进行隐秘活动：间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]已经开始执行谍报章程。我们新建立的§H间谍网§!让我们可以观察[from.target.GetAdj]的活动，并在必要的时候渗透并介入。
descriptions.en: Our presence in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has taken on a clandestine aspect: Spymaster [from.leader.GetName] has engaged Espionage protocols. Our newly-established §HSpy Network§! will allow us to observe [from.target.GetAdj] activities, infiltrating and intervening where necessary.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

descriptions.zh: 我们收到了间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!发回的第一份密报，标志着我们在外星人地盘上的第一个§H间谍网§!的建立。无论何时他们采取行动，我们都会有更多的机会将他们玩弄于[owner.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。
descriptions.en: We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the establishment of our first §HSpy Network§! within xeno territory. Whenever they make a move, we stand a better chance of it playing right into our [owner.species.GetHandNamePlural].

options.script: name = OK

descriptions.zh: 我们收到了间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!发回的第一份密报，标志着我们在外星帝国的第一个§H间谍网§!的基本成型，这将有效提醒我们提防那些外星杂碎们的阴谋诡计。
descriptions.en: We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a xeno empire - ideally positioned to warn us of their alien and duplicitous schemes.

options.script: name = SCUM

descriptions.zh: 我们收到了间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!发回的第一份密报，宣告了我们在外星帝国的第一个§H间谍网§!的基本成型。从今往后，他们也将意识到这对于[owner.species.GetAdj]长久的好处，比如能锻炼一下机密管控能力……
descriptions.en: We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This heralds the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a xeno empire. From this day forward, they too will realize the formative benefits of [owner.species.GetAdj]-honed information control...

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
已经有报告陆续地从被派遣到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]发送过来了。这标志着我们在一个外星帝国开始建立了我们第一个§H间谍网§!。

尽管我们在表面上看上去相似，但是我们应该很快就能发现这些特定的[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是如何可能与我们相异甚远……
descriptions.en:
Reports have started coming in from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the beginning of our first §HSpy Network§! within a foreign empire.

Though we may look alike on the surface, we shall soon discover just how these particular [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] might differ from ourselves...

descriptions.zh:
被分配到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!开展工作的间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]开始传来报告。这标志着我们在这个尚未意识到外星生命存在的星球里建立了首个§H间谍网§!。

若计划妥当，我们能够潜移默化地影响这个[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，同时掩盖我们的存在。值得庆幸的是，我们物种和[from.target.species.GetName]有着惊人的生理相似性，这能让我们的特工很难被发现。
descriptions.en:
Reports have started coming in from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a world which is still unaware of alien life.

With careful planning, we will be able to subtly influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society while keeping our existence hidden. Luckily for us, the extraordinary physical similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] will make it easy for our operatives to remain undetected.

descriptions.zh:
被分配到§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]开始传来报告。这标志着我们在这个最近才开始考虑外星生命是否存在的社会里建立了首个§H间谍网§!。

我们仍有一线机会来潜移默化地影响这个尚未掌握星际航行技术的社会。我们物种和[from.target.species.GetName]具有生理相似性，这应该能让我们的特工轻松地在暗中进行工作。
descriptions.en:
Reports have started coming in from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a society which has only recently begun to consider the presence of alien life.

We now have a rare opportunity to subtly influence a society not yet capable of interstellar flight. The physiological similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] should make it easy for our operatives to work undetected.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
仔细研究§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的居民后，我们学会了如何让[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]复制[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的行为。间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]是我们总管在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]星球上的首个§H间谍网§!的[root.GetIndividualName]。

若计划妥当，我们能够根据自身利益潜移默化地影响这个社会，同时掩盖我们的行踪。
descriptions.en:
After carefully studying the inhabitants of §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, we have learned how to adapt our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] to replicate [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] behavior. Spymaster [from.leader.GetName] is one such [root.GetIndividualName]: the head of our first §HSpy Network§! on [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] world.

With careful planning, we will be able to subtly influence this society to suit our needs while keeping our presence hidden.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

descriptions.zh:
仔细研究§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的居民后，我们学会了如何校准子个体，使其复制[from.target.GetAdj]的行为。子个体间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]是我们在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]星球的首个§H间谍网§!的总管。

[from.target.species.GetName]是简单的有机生物，仍未意识到外星生命的存在。若要保持现状，我们的特工需要进行大量的机器改造，大规模使用诱饵，以掩盖自己的真实面目。
descriptions.en:
After careful study of the inhabitants of §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, we have learned how to recalibrate our drones to replicate [from.target.GetAdj] behavior. Spymaster [from.leader.GetName] is one such drone: the head of our first §HSpy Network§! on [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] world.

The [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, still unaware of alien life. If we are to preserve this illusion, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.

descriptions.zh:
仔细研究§Y[from.target.GetName]§!的居民后，我们学会了如何校准子个体，使其复制[from.target.GetAdj]的行为。子个体间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]是我们在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]星球的首个§H间谍网§!的总管。

[from.target.species.GetName]是简单的有机生物，刚刚开始接受外星生命的概念。若要有效地执行任务，我们的特工需要进行大量的机器改造，大规模使用诱饵，以掩盖自己的真实面目。
descriptions.en:
After careful study of the inhabitants of §Y[from.target.GetName]§!, we have learned how to recalibrate our drones to replicate [from.target.GetAdj] behavior. Spymaster [from.leader.GetName] is one such drone: the head of our first §HSpy Network§! on [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] world.

The [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, only now adjusting to the concept of alien life. If we are to conduct our operations effectively, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会的第一个§H间谍网§!已经夯实基础。

这些异种还没有染指外星生命的知识，他们的技术也远不如我们。操纵他们轻而易举——我们只需保持身份隐蔽。
descriptions.en:
We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society.

These xenos are as yet untainted by the knowledge of alien life, and their technology is far inferior to ours. Manipulating them will be easy - we just have to make sure our identity remains concealed.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会的第一个§H间谍网§!已经夯实基础。

这些异种最近才开始思考外星生命。尽管他们的社会看起来无懈可击，但他们科技落后，要操纵他们轻而易举——我们只需保持身份隐蔽。
descriptions.en:
We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society.

These xenos have only recently begun to conceive of alien life. Untainted though their society appears to be, their inferior technology makes them easy targets for us to manipulate - just so long as our identity remains concealed.

options.script: name = SCUM

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在这个尚未意识到外星生命的星球里的第一个§H间谍网§!夯实了基础。

这是研究[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，并促进其繁荣发展的绝佳时机！在他们做好准备之前，我们只能小心谨慎，不要暴露真实面目。我们不能冒险破坏他们的社会稳定。
descriptions.en:
We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a world still unaware of alien life.

It is an incredible opportunity to study [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society and steer it in a more prosperous direction! We just have to be careful not to reveal our true nature until they're ready. We cannot risk destabilizing their society.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在这个最近才开始思考外星生命是否存在的社会里的第一个§H间谍网§!夯实了基础！

这是研究[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，并促进其繁荣发展的绝佳时机。如果我们愿意的话，也能帮助他们维系独特的社会。
descriptions.en:
We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a society so recently coming to grips with the idea of alien life!

It is an incredible opportunity to not only study [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society, but also steer it in a more prosperous direction - or help them preserve their unique society, if we so wish.

options.script: name = GOOD

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会的第一个§H间谍网§!已经夯实基础。

这份努力让我们有了难得的契机，来影响[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会，同时也带来了一些棘手的问题：也就是说，我们的特工必须小心地掩盖自己的外星身份。粗心大意可能会引发无法预料的后果。
descriptions.en:
We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society.

This endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society, as well as presenting some unique problems: namely, our operatives will have to carefully conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may lead to unforeseen consequences.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了间谍首脑[from.leader.GetName]从§Y[from.target.GetName]§!内部发回的第一份密报。这标志着我们在[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower][root.GetPreFTLLower]社会的第一个§H间谍网§!已经夯实基础。

这份努力让我们有了难得的契机，来影响这个最近才开始接受外星生命可能性的文明。不论他们的社会前景如何，我们的特工在掩盖外星身份的前提下会全力以赴。粗心大意可能会引发无法预料的后果。
descriptions.en:
We have received our first clandestine report from Spymaster [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] society.

This endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence a civilization which has only recently begun to grapple with the possibilities of alien life. Regardless of their societal outlook: our operatives will work best if they can conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may yet lead to unforeseen consequences.

options.script: name = OK

descriptions.zh:
一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新激活了。这件事关系到我们先前在§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!开展的行动，似乎是某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报。

信息细节上很含糊，但是这段代码携带了关于一个外星帝国§H关键政治人物§!情报的标记。

我方安全顾问确认这套代码不久前仍然可用，但代码的到期意味着外国势力介入的可能。况且我们也没有证据表明特工或是信息本身的是真是假。
descriptions.en:
A long-expired set of covert codes has just been re-activated. They are linked to Operations we previously carried out in the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, from where it would seem a former operative is trying to report back in.

The message is light on details, but the code carries markers which signify intelligence on §Hkey political figures§! in a foreign empire.

Our security advisors confirm that the codes were valid until quite recently, but their expiry means such codes are open to compromise by foreign powers. There's no telling if the operative or their message are genuine.

descriptions.zh:
一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新激活了。这件事关系到我们先前在§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!开展的行动，似乎是某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报。

信息细节上很含糊，但是这段代码携带了关于一个外星帝国§H关键政治人物§!情报的标记。

该情报人员已被宣告失联，安全顾问建议我们应当慎重考量。废弃的代码和甚至可能已经不知所踪的特工——我们应当假设其已经叛变。
descriptions.en:
A long-expired set of covert codes has just been re-activated. They are linked to Operations we previously carried out in the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, from where it would seem a former operative is trying to report back in.

The message is light on details, but the code carries markers which signify intelligence on §Hkey political figures§! in a foreign empire.

The operative had been declared lost, and as such our security advisors advise extreme caution. Expired codes - and perhaps even lost operatives - are assumed to be already compromised.

label.zh: 前代理已被除名，将其忽略。
label.en: Former agents are to be disavowed. Ignore this.

descriptions.zh: 我们又收到了一段来自§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!境内的加密信息，这次采用了另一套加密。如我们料想的一样，一度失联的特工声称他们所持有的情报使他们处于极度危险之中。他们声称如果我们不采取行动救援的话，就会考虑§H叛变§!。
descriptions.en: We've received another encrypted message from within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, employing a different cipher this time. Our supposed, once-lost operative claims that the knowledge they hold puts their life at extreme risk. They say that if we do not extract and debrief them, they must consider §Hdefecting§!.

label.zh: 空洞而可疑的威胁，继续忽略。
label.en: An empty and suspicious threat. Continue to ignore.

label.zh: 好吧。准备一支救援小队。

descriptions.zh:
§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!境内再也没有收到我们的那位除名特工发来的消息了。我们认为这个问题已经被解决了。

我们也许永远也不会知道是否真的有一位前特工存在，也不会知道他是否真的持有有用的情报。如果这确系[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]的阴谋的话，我们可以放心地说：他们的诡计失败了。
descriptions.en:
There have been no further messages from our disavowed operative within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. The matter is being considered as resolved.

We may never know if there really was a former operative - nor will we know if there actually was useful intelligence to be had. If this was instead a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ruse: we can safely state that their ploy has failed.

options.script:
name = GOOD
end_event_chain = operative_resurfaces_chain

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了一份来自§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!由[disavowed_agent_official.GetName]发出的非常愤怒的公告，宣称有个人前来与[disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap]接触，却又表明自己曾是§H[root.GetAdj]间谍§!。[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]代表不过只言片语，却强烈表明了他们对于“异国特工”的忍无可忍。

如果这条信息属实，可能那位除名特工已经遭遇不测了。不管怎样，这件事都连带造成了些许外交结果。
descriptions.en:
We have received a rather brusk communiqué from [disavowed_agent_official.GetName] of the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. [disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap] claim[disavowed_agent_official.GetSXX] to have been approached by someone who had, in turn, identified themself as a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!. The [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] representative used few words, but keenly expressed their empire's narrow tolerance for 'foreign agents'.

If any part of this message is to be believed, it is likely the disavowed operative has met a fatal end. Either way: this matter carries some diplomatic consequences.

descriptions.zh:
我们从§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!收到了一份出离愤怒的声明。他们宣称受到了一位§H前[root.GetAdj]间谍§!的渗透，我们应该对此负责。此外，此人将会依据他们对“境外间谍”的相关政策受到一切可能的刑罚。

如果这条信息属实，可能那位除名特工已经遭遇不测了。不管怎样，这件事都连带造成了些许外交结果。
descriptions.en:
We have received a rather brusk statement from the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. They claim to have been approached by a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!, and that we are to be held to account. Furthermore, this individual is set to suffer every punishment their society has set for 'foreign agents'.

If any part of this message is to be believed, it is likely the disavowed operative has met a fatal end. Either way: this matter carries some diplomatic consequences.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到来自§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的一篇不寻常的通报，他们宣称已经被§H[root.GetAdj]前特工§!渗透。如果属实，那这位除名特工确实存在，并且已经迫于压力而背叛——他所面临的则是被[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]政府彻底消灭。通报是这么写的。

[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]并没有清楚表明他们的下一步动向，但这样的人如果他还留在原处，必然还会被安置在层层监视之下。依照国际惯例，[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]已经因为这起“侵犯主权领域”事件签署了针对我们的外交制裁。
descriptions.en:
We have received an unusual statement from the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, claiming they have been approached by a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!. If the message is to be believed, the disavowed operative not only exists, but felt no recourse other than to defect - only to be dismissed outright by [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] authorities. Or so the message claims.

The [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] do not state precisely what their next course of action will be, but such an individual would almost certainly be placed under close observation for as long as they remain there. As a formality, the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] have issued a diplomatic sanction against us for this 'violation of sovereign territory'.

descriptions.zh:
我方安全顾问报告称我们在§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的前特工可能造成的威胁已经被全部扫清。一支精挑细选的特遣队确认了此个体的真实存在，并迅速将其消灭。然而没人能确定该个体真是我们的特工，还是[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]诡计的一部分。

不管怎样，这名特工和其声称所持有的情报现已不会被任何帝国知晓了。
descriptions.en:
Our security advisors report an end to any threat which may have been posed by our former operative in the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. A specially-chosen task force was able to confirm the existence of this individual - before swiftly ending it. However, no one can be certain if this was a genuine operative, or part of a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ploy.

Either way: both the operative's existence and the information they claimed to hold have now been put safely beyond the reach of either empire.

descriptions.zh:
位于§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!境内试图重新取得联系的前特工已经被悉数处理干净。一支精挑细选的特遣队确认了此个体的真实存在，并迅速将其消灭。然而没人能确定该个体真是我们的特工，还是[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]诡计的一部分。

不管怎样，这名特工和其声称所持有的情报现已不会被任何帝国知晓了。
descriptions.en:
The former operative who had attempted to regain contact from within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§! has been cleanly dealt with. A specially-chosen task force was able to confirm the existence of this individual - before swiftly ending it. However, no one can be certain if this was a genuine operative, or part of a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ploy.

Either way: both the operative's existence and the information they claimed to hold have now been put safely beyond the reach of either empire.

options.script:
name = ACKNOWLEDGED
end_event_chain = operative_resurfaces_chain

descriptions.zh:
我们派遣到§Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的秘密强袭小队匆匆返回了。我们的小队发现似乎其实并没有什么除名的特工。取而代之的，小队从蛛丝马迹中发现这一切都是为了暴露我们的秘密行动而设下的全套。

也许这是为了进一步实现[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]目标的计划；又或者是另一个外部势力正在介入其中。但无论如何：我们都要及时终止遏制措施以避免暴露我们一直以来的情报活动。
descriptions.en:
The clandestine strike team we sent into the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§! have returned with great haste. It seems there never was a disavowed operative. Instead what the team found was subtle evidence of a plot to expose our clandestine operations.

Perhaps this was a scheme intended to further [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] goals; perhaps an external body sought to meddle in our affairs. In either case: our containment measures were aborted just in time to avoid exposing our intelligence operations, past or present.

descriptions.zh:
我们一度被除名的特工自行设法回到了[root.GetAdj]境内。这名§H[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]个体§!——称[disavowed_operative.GetHimselfHerself]自己为[disavowed_operative.GetName]——又紧张又如释重负，但好在还是通过了全部安全验证。任务简报中报告的行动显得尤为艰难，但其中的信息被证明相当有用——我们现在能获取一位能干的§Y线人§!。

由于事态已经解决，[disavowed_operative.GetName]悬而未决的除名流程现在被更新。确认了[disavowed_operative.GetHeShe]没有在行动中失踪之后，我们现役的特工确信这次除名不再生效。
descriptions.en:
Our once-disavowed operative has made it back to [root.GetAdj] space. This §H[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] individual§! - who identified [disavowed_operative.GetHimselfHerself] as [disavowed_operative.GetName] - appears nervous and relieved, but has cleared all security verification. The debriefing has been described as arduous, but the information has proven to be useful - we have now gained access to a valuable §YAsset§!.

With the matter now resolved, [disavowed_operative.GetName]'s shaky disavowal will be renewed. Having confirmed that [disavowed_operative.GetHeShe] [disavowed_operative.GetIsAre] no longer missing in action, our current operatives can ensure that this time, the disavowal will stick.

descriptions.zh:
看来我们在追寻想要的§H被除名特工§!时太过着急了。被我们派往§H[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!的特勤小队现已完全失联。我们现在怀疑所谓的特工并不存在。

所有参与该行动的特工现均被除名。因此，由于间谍网亟待恢复，我们于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]进行长远行动的能力在近期将被削弱。
descriptions.en:
It appears we acted too hastily in trying to extract our supposed, §Hdisavowed operative§!. We have entirely lost contact with the team of operatives we dispatched to the §H[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. We now suspect that the operative never existed.

All operatives who were associated with this endeavor have been disavowed. As a result, our ability to conduct further operations in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] will be restricted for a time as the Spy Network recovers.

descriptions.zh:
某些位于§H[vividsight_country.GetName]§!听从我们指令的特工开始引起不必要的注意——他们某种程度上成为了……红人？

我们没有理由相信他们的身份暴露了，但是他们不断增长的名声和影响力让我们在隐蔽间谍网方面愈发紧张兮兮。
descriptions.en:
Some of the operatives we control in the §H[vividsight_country.GetName]§! are beginning to draw unusual amounts of attention; they are regarded as somehow... attractive?

We have no reason to believe their cover identities are in jeopardy, but their growing notoriety and influence put strain on the deniability of our Spy Network.

label.zh: 如果运筹得当，我们可以将其转化为优势。
label.en: This could be advantageous, if managed well.

label.zh: 这么做不妥。安排一些“调动”。
label.en: This will not do. Arrange for 'adjustments'.

descriptions.zh:
我们正在观察§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!的间谍首脑报告了一次新的，令人惊讶的§Y线人§!获取——一名负责交感神经接触的子个体现在为我们的行动服务。

我们已尽一切努力确保这次新的接触不是一个陷阱。例如，我们现在已经制定了一些协议，以尽量减少该线人为双重间谍的可能性。
descriptions.en:
Our Spymaster watching over the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! reports the surprise, successful acquisition of a new §YAsset§! - a sympathetic contact who will be of service to our operations as and when we need them.

All efforts have been taken to ensure that this new contact is genuine. Protocols have been established which seek to minimize the risk of potential double agents, for example.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!所进行的诸多隐秘任务就包括低调地搜罗潜在的线人：任何可以帮助我们进一步深入格式塔实体的工具。我们的间谍首脑报告刚刚有了一个幸运的发现。
descriptions.en: Amongst our many clandestine tasks in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! is the low-key scouting of potential Assets: any tool we can use to further our efforts amongst the gestalt entity. Our Spymaster reports having just made one such lucky catch.

descriptions.zh:
我们成功地让一群§P[luckycatch_country.GetAdj]敌特§!落入了我们的罗网。他们似乎正在从事危害我方的行动，但细节尚不清楚。

不过，经由审讯，我们已经搜集到了少许关于§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!的情报。我方间谍首脑还联系上了一名当地§Y线人§!以对这些情报进行利用。
descriptions.en:
We have have trapped a group of §P[luckycatch_country.GetAdj] spies§!. It seems they were engaged in an operation against us, the details of which are unknown to us yet.

Through our interrogations, however, we have gathered some small amount of Intel on the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!. Our Spymaster now also has access to a local §YAsset§! with which we can press this advantage.

descriptions.zh:
我们位于§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!的间谍首脑发来报告，一批§P敌特§!业已落网。虽然近日来其对我们的不利行动已不可挽回，但事实证明，对这些人的审讯是有价值的。

我们由此获得的情报的时效并不长，但这些敌特的落网使得我们对抗[luckycatch_country.GetName]的行动取得了一定优势。我们已在这些人中发展了一些§Y线人§!，以备不时之需。
descriptions.en:
Our Spymaster in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! reports that we have successfully captured a band of §Psaboteurs§!. Though we were unable to prevent their recent act of aggression against us, our interrogations of the hostile operatives has proven lucrative.

The intelligence we've gathered will not serve us for long, but capturing these saboteurs has granted us an advantage in our own operations against the [luckycatch_country.GetName]. Through them, we have secured an §YAsset§! to aid us when required.

tooltips.zh: 我们已设法在§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!安插了一名为我们的间谍网服务的§Y新线人§!。
tooltips.en: We have acquired a §Ynew Asset§! for our Spy Network in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!.

tooltips.zh: 我们已设法在§H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!安插了一名为我们的间谍网服务的§Y新线人§!。
tooltips.en: We have acquired a §Ynew Asset§! for our Spy Network in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh:
§H[finderskeepers_country.GetAdj]加密密钥§!的一部分落入了位于§Y[finderskeepers_country.GetName]§!的一名格外眼尖的特工[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。看起来是某位粗心的[finderskeepers_country.GetSpeciesName]政客在通勤时落下了这一设备。

这对于我们在[finderskeepers_country.GetName]中的行动而言是个好兆头，而且就这一设备独特设计的研究揭示了若干有助于我们通用§Y破译§!方法研发的新颖洞见。
descriptions.en:
A particularly observant operative in the §Y[finderskeepers_country.GetName]§! has laid their [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] on part of a §H[finderskeepers_country.GetAdj] encryption key§!. It would seem a careless [finderskeepers_country.GetSpeciesName] Politician mislaid the device whilst commuting.

This bodes well enough for our operations in the [finderskeepers_country.GetName], but our study of the device's unique design has revealed novel insights for our general approach to §YCodebreaking§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[capital_scope.GetName]的一名政客一时大意，将一组敏感材料放错了位置，其中包括一个即使只是单纯将其带出政府机关外也已经严重违反协议的§H加密密钥§!。

我国内政部门正在抢救式切换安保平台，因为这些材料很可能已经落入敌对势力[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。
descriptions.en:
One of our Politicians on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an §Hencryption key§! whose very existence outside of government facilities is a gross breach of protocol.

Our domestic authorities are scrambling to switch security platforms, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into hostile [root.species.GetHandNamePlural].

descriptions.zh:
我们在[capital_scope.GetName]的一名[root.GetCorpRulerJobPlural]一时大意，将一组敏感材料放错了位置，其中包括一个即使只是单纯将其带出政府机关外也已经严重违反协议的§H加密密钥§!。

我方安全团队正在抢救式切换安保平台，因为这些材料很可能已经落入我们的竞争者[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。
descriptions.en:
One of our [root.GetCorpRulerJobPlural] on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an §Hencryption key§! whose mere existence outside of strictly-defined zones is a gross breach of protocol.

Our security teams are scrambling to switch operating procedures, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into the [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] of our competitors.

tooltips.zh: 我国首都的一名£job_politician£§Y政客§!将被开除及§R降阶§!。
tooltips.en: A £job_politician£ §YPolitician§! on our capital is fired and §Rdemoted§!.

tooltips.zh: 我国首都的一名§Y[root.GetCorpRulerJobIcon]§!将被开除及§R降阶§!。
tooltips.en: A §Y[root.GetCorpRulerJobIcon]§! on our capital is fired and §Rdemoted§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们的加密措施抓获了一帮危险的潜伏者。这些潜在敌人似乎为§H[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§!工作，其阴谋原本会使许多[root.species.GetAdj]人民丧生并对我方造成显著破坏。

我们设法§Y解密§!了他们携带着的各种材料，但没有一个材料能展现出他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；我们也无法断言他们下一步会做什么。我们获得的情报因而相对较少。

我们必须仔细考虑如何应对。也许我们希望隐藏自身的能力，在星系中的其他邻居面前假装无知。不过，我们也可以正大光明地谴责这次针对我们的未遂暴力袭击。
descriptions.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of dangerous infiltrators. These would-be hostiles appear to be working on behalf of the §H[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§!, on a scheme which would have cost many [root.species.GetAdj] lives and caused us significant damage.

We have managed to §Ydecrypt§! various materials they were carrying, however none lays out the full scope of their plans against us; nor are we able to say with certainty what their next move may be. Our Intel gains are therefore relatively small.

We must carefully consider how to respond. We may wish to keep quiet about our own capabilities, feigning ignorance in front of our other galactic neighbors. We would, however, also be justified in publicly denouncing this planned act of violence against us.

descriptions.zh:
我们的加密措施抓获了一帮危险的潜伏者。这些潜在敌人似乎为§H[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§!工作，其阴谋原本会使许多[root.species.GetAdj]人民丧生并对我方造成显著破坏。

我们从他们身上武力夺取的材料中包括大量通讯日志，并且我们设法解密了日志。没有一份日志描述了他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；[hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj]的安保看上去至少相当有能量，我们只能获取零星的情报。我们获知的一切消息都算不上可靠。

尽管我们的愤怒来得合理正当，明智来讲我们需要考虑如何回应。我们可能希望隐藏自身的加密能力，在敌人面前假装无能。不过，我们也可以将[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]针对我们的未遂暴力行动公之于众，也许敌人中也会有人对我们表示同情。
descriptions.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of dangerous infiltrators. These would-be hostiles appear to be working on behalf of the §H[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§!, on a scheme which would have cost many [root.species.GetAdj] lives and caused us significant damage.

Amongst the materials we forcibly extracted from them were a number of communication logs, which we have managed to decrypt. None describes the full scope of their plans against us; [hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj] security seems at least capable enough to yield only patchy Intel to us. Everything else we may extract from them is deemed unreliable information.

Despite the justified outrage we may wish to express, we would be wise to consider our response. We could keep quiet about our own Encryption skill, feigning ineptitude in front of our enemies. Were we to expose the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] for this planned act of violence against us, however, we might find those enemies even regarding us with sympathy.

descriptions.zh:
我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验明身份。

这些状似特工的[hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]们携带了各式牵连他人的物件，其中有些我们很容易解密。不过，我们怀疑这些东西是伪造的，用来误导或者欺骗我方。这些间谍或许的确替[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，但证据算不上确凿。

以防万一，保持密切地监视[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]或许是值得的。不过，保持沉默或许也有好处，以免走漏我们在安保方面相对虚弱的一面。
descriptions.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. They claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

These [hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]-looking operatives were carrying various incriminating items, some of which we were easily able to decrypt. We suspect, however, that these items are a fabricated distraction or ruse. These spies may indeed be working for the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], but the evidence is inconclusive.

It may be worthwhile keeping a closer watch on the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], just in case. However, it may also benefit us to keep quiet and not let slip the comparative weakness of our own security.

descriptions.zh:
我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验证。

这些状似特工的[hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]们携带了各式牵连他人的物件，其中有些我们很容易解密。不过，我们怀疑这些东西是伪造的，用来误导或者欺骗我方。这些间谍或许的确替[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，但证据算不上确凿。

我们可以对[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]进行报复——这样的行动甚至会被他国视作正当之举。不过，也有可能整起事件都是个诱饵，用来转移我们对真正敌人的注意力。
descriptions.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. Even under interrogation they claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

These [hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]-looking operatives were carrying various incriminating items, some of which we were easily able to decrypt. We suspect, however, that these items are a fabricated distraction or ruse. These spies may indeed be working for the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], but the evidence is inconclusive.

We could retaliate against the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] - such action may even be deemed justified by others. However, it's possible this entire incident is a clever lure, put in place to distract us from our true enemies.

label.zh: 整个星系都应该听听这个！
label.en: The galaxy shall hear of this!

tooltips.zh: §H§Y[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§!将会被通知自己的间谍被捕了§!
tooltips.en: §HThe §Y[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§! will be informed that we caught their operatives.§!

label.en: Let them buy our silence in this matter.

tooltips.zh: §H§Y[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§!将会被通知自己的间谍被捕了§!
tooltips.en: §HThe §Y[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§! will be informed that we caught their operatives.§!

descriptions.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，§Y[from.GetName]§!，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方行动§P公之于众§!！。

有可能他们并没有能够支撑这些指控且可以验证的证据——只有少数国家会选择相信他们。不过，单是这些指控本身可能就足以造成危害了。
descriptions.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have not only seen through our scheme but have chosen to §Pexpose us§! for our actions!

It's possible that no verifiable evidence backs up these claims - few may choose to believe them. The accusation alone may be damaging enough, however.

descriptions.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，§Y[from.GetName]§!，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方的敌对行动§P公之于众§!！。

有可能他们并未对此掌握实际证据——他们也许只是试图虚张声势来侮辱我们，或者是从他们在星系中的邻居那里赢取支持。
descriptions.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have not only seen through our scheme but have decided to §Pexpose us§! for our actions against them.

It's possible that they hold no actual evidence for this - they may simply try to bluff their way to insulting us or earning favor with their galactic neighbors.

label.en: Two can play at that game.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§H[from.GetName]§!指控我方进行§P敌对谍报活动§!。他们的宣称——我方派遣特工从事龌龊的侵略举动——完全是基于谎言、虚假消息和不实的论据之上。

不管理由如何，这一指控导致了[from.GetName]对我们的外交制裁。我们大概不会看到由此带来任何直接后果，但他们的盟友，甚或我们自己的盟友都不会对这种诋毁视而不见。
descriptions.en:
The §H[from.GetName]§! accuses us of §Phostile espionage§!. Their claims - that we sent operatives to conduct abhorrent acts of aggression against them - are built upon shaky and misattributed evidence.

Whatever the credibility or reasoning behind this allegation, it has resulted in a diplomatic sanction from the [from.GetName]. We are not likely to see any direct consequences from this, but it's unlikely this smear will go unnoticed by any of their other allies, or even our own.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，§Y[from.GetName]§!，将我方情报人员当场抓获且§H要求外交支持§!。作为交换，他们同意不将我们的隐秘行动公诸星海。

有可能他们的指控并没有实际证据来支撑，但无论如何这一指控本身就足以对我们造成损害。不论动机如何，[from.GetName]已经要求从我方获得政治好处。
descriptions.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have caught us in the act and §Hdemanded political favors§!. In doing so, they have agreed not to expose our covert actions to the wider galaxy.

It's possible that no actual evidence backs up their claims - the accusation alone could cause us enough damage anyway. Whatever their motivation is, the [from.GetName] have claimed political leverage on us.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§!的特工发现了一些不寻常的事情：有可靠线索表明，§H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§!正阴谋欺骗我方！我们尚不掌握这一可疑的计划的具体细节，但据称其中包括对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。

虽然完全不清楚[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]是如何获知这些情报的。不过我们的特工追踪可疑的[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj]特工的努力似乎已经有了回报。但如果这些情报是真的，[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]可能只是艰辛地为我们收集了该情报。
descriptions.en:
Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered something unusual: credible hints that the §H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§! are plotting to deceive us! We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.

Quite how this information came to be known by the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] is unclear. Our own operatives' efforts to tail suspected [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj] intelligence operatives seem to have paid off, though. If this intelligence is genuine, the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] may just have done the hard work of gathering it for us.

label.zh: 这种潜在的恶行不可容忍。
label.en: This potential outrage cannot be tolerated.

label.zh: 这很可能是个陷阱，别管它。
label.en: This is likely a ploy. Ignore it.

descriptions.zh:
我们被牵连进了一个针对§H[from.GetName]§!的阴谋中。这一指控是如此地含糊，以至于我们靠自己根本无从得知他们是否真的掌握了我们的把柄。

我们自己的间谍抗议说，这一指控毫无根据，声称这可能是我们目标之一的防御性、反间谍行动，抑或是来自第三方的抹黑。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。
descriptions.en:
We have been implicated in a plot against the §H[from.GetName]§!. So vague is the allegation that we cannot definitively state whether or not they are on to something.

Our own spies protest that the allegation is baseless, claiming this is likely either a defensive, counter-espionage response from one of our targets - or else a smear campaign being conducted by some third party. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.

descriptions.zh:
令人惊讶的是，我们被毫无来由地指控参与到针对§H[from.GetName]§!的阴谋中。这一指控十分荒谬，因为我们近来委实未曾发起对外的间谍活动——但另一方面，[from.GetAdj]根本不知道这一指控有多荒谬。

似乎不明身份的人在试图陷害我们，从而为他们自己的不轨行为开脱——抑或是单纯为了制造外交混乱。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。
descriptions.en:
Amazingly, we have been implicated in some vaguely-defined plot against the §H[from.GetName]§!. It's a ridiculous allegation, given our complete lack of foreign espionage activity so far - but then, the [from.GetAdj] would have no way of knowing how truly ridiculous the allegation is.

It would seem that parties unknown are attempting to frame us for their own misdemeanors - or perhaps simply to sow some diplomatic chaos. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.
